Scripts under scripts/ launch live model seats: scripts/sandbox-claude-live.ts:62 (spawn("claude", ...)), scripts/bench-rq1.ts:164 (spawn("claude", ...); it also binds 127.0.0.1 ports at bench-rq1.ts:391-394), scripts/bench-build-runtime.ts:145 (detached spawn("claude", ...)) and scripts/adjudication-replay.ts:89 (claude -p judge). The verifier independently found more: bench-steer-claude.ts:65 spawns claude, and openrouter-smoke.ts:103 binds a fixed STUB_PORT. None of them is in the explicit offlineScripts list (scripts/offline-runner.mjs:26-182), so globbing scripts/* would pull live, paid, networked runs into the offline suite.

challenge.objection: "it also binds 127.0.0.1 ports at bench-rq1.ts:391-394" overstates it. Those lines are a free-port probe that listens and closes immediately. The hub/stub actually bound is elsewhere, and openrouter-smoke.ts:103 is the real long-lived bind. Please reword that as a port probe. A stronger point is missing: the listed counterpart scripts/bench-rq1.test.ts:1-3,22-29 runs bench-rq1.ts against a stub `claude` on PATH. That shows the list deliberately includes only stubbed variants, which is exactly what the comment protects.
